name: r6-step
summary: Climb round 6: step-start collectives (C3: column-sharded embedding with AG instead of AR for the target and DSpark embeddings; one packed rows gather and optionally one packed wkv gather for the two Engram layers) and the E1 DSpark main_proj local GEMM on a side stream from the CERT screen's end to combine_hidden_states (C4). Two anchor-patched live files + one new module; every flag default off and inert when off.

flags.name: DSV41_STEP_COLEMB
flags.meaning: target (eager) and DSpark (in-graph) embeddings: column-table lookup + one column all-gather instead of vocab-parallel lookup + all-reduce, for 0 < T <= DSV41_STEP_COLEMB_MAX_T (default 128, capped at the rows whose stock AR is the rdma path). Table built eagerly once from the live path with a full-table owner-row check vs canon(W) on every rank + cross-rank checksum; refuses on any mismatch. +165 MB/rank.

flags.name: DSV41_STEP_COLEMB_MAX_T
flags.meaning: largest row count that takes the column path

flags.name: DSV41_STEP_ENGRAM_PACK
flags.meaning: look: Engram layers 1 and 14 share one rows all-gather at layer 1's Engram.embed (4 -> 3 Engram collectives). all: also one wkv all-gather at layer 1 with layer 14's wkv GEMM run right after layer 1's on main (4 -> 2). all falls back to look while DSV41_PRIO_ENGRAM_HOIST is on. Decode-sized forwards only, never in a breakable capture, SP, EngramBatch or Engram DP > 1.

flags.name: DSV41_STEP_C4
flags.meaning: CERT-armed steps: cat + MXFP8 quant + CUTLASS GEMM of the r4 column-split main_proj on a side stream forked after the screen kernel; combine_hidden_states waits on its event and runs the all-gather + main_norm on main where the stock path does. Refused while DSV41_MAINPROJ_HOIST (G12) is on.

flags.name: DSV41_STEP_C4_AUDIT
flags.meaning: first N consumed steps: also recompute the stock local GEMM at combine time, compare bitwise on device, and SERVE the stock result (so the audit arm is exact whether or not C4 is); one host read at step N; mismatch disables C4. Audit arms only (puts the GEMM back on the critical path for N steps).

COLEMB.basis: t2: eager embedding AR 24.5-31.5 us -> eager column AG (E1 main_proj AG [M,640] 16-22 us) saves 3-15; drafter embedding AR 26.6-32.1 us (two-shot, no paced prefetch in its window) -> in-graph AG (drafter AG p50 12.0-12.3) saves 13-19

PACK_look.basis: t2: layer-14 rows AG 19.8-21.6 us + 1.05 us gaps removed; +cat +split copy +bigger AG 5-7 us; the removed window carried 18-22 us of paced L2 prefetch (fully covered): up to ~17 us of DRAM hiding may be lost unless the planner re-places it; new wait on layer 14's lookup event at layer 1 costs 0 on t2 (scripts/engwait_t2.txt: lookup ends >= 379 us before layer 1's rows AG in all 360 forwards)

PACK_all_extra.basis: t2: layer-14 wkv AG 24.8-33.6 us + 1.24 gaps removed; +cat +copy +2x payload 8-12 us; window carried 10-13 us of paced prefetch. GEMMs stay on the critical path (same total)

C4.basis: t2 E1 (6 traces): quant 3.7-4.3 + GEMM 61.4-64.8 us + 2 gaps leave main; side chain needs ~70 us from screen end, main reaches combine 126-215 us (p10 114-155) after it -> hidden; contention with refine/argmax 3-15 us. Low: G12-chain (same fork point) measured -0.95% in w2 with no root cause found
